name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.negFamily

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.Bracket
source_signature:
inductive Bracket where
  | round | square | curly
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.openTok
source_signature:
def openTok : Bracket → Tok
  | .round => .punct .lparen
  | .square => .punct .lbrack
  | .curly => .punct .lbrace

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.closeTok
source_signature:
def closeTok : Bracket → Tok
  | .round => .punct .rparen
  | .square => .punct .rbrack
  | .curly => .punct .rbrace

/-- `true` opens a delimiter, `false` closes one. -/

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.bracket
source_signature:
def bracket : Tok → Option (Bool × Bracket)
  | .punct .lparen => some (true, .round)
  | .punct .lbrack => some (true, .square)
  | .punct .lbrace => some (true, .curly)
  | .punct .rparen => some (false, .round)
  | .punct .rbrack => some (false, .square)
  | .punct .rbrace => some (false, .curly)
  | _ => none

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.run
source_signature:
def run (s : List Bracket) : List Tok → Option (List Bracket)
  | [] => some s
  | t :: ts => (step s t).bind fun next => run next ts

/-- Balanced in every surrounding delimiter context. -/

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.Balanced

source_signature:
theorem step_suffix (t : Tok) (s next tail : List Bracket)
    (h : step s t = some next) : step (s ++ tail) t = some (next ++ tail)

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.run_suffix
source_signature:
theorem run_suffix (ts : List Tok) (s next tail : List Bracket)
    (h : run s ts = some next) : run (s ++ tail) ts = some (next ++ tail)

theorem run_append (xs ys : List Tok) (s : List Bracket) :
    run s (xs ++ ys) = (run s xs).bind (fun next => run next ys)

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.balanced_append

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.skip
source_signature:
def skip (p : Tok → Bool) (s : List Bracket) : List Tok → Option (List Bracket)
  | [] => some s
  | t :: ts =>
    if s.isEmpty && p t then none
    else (step s t).bind fun next => skip p next ts

theorem firstTop_append_of_skip (p : Tok → Bool) (xs ys : List Tok)
    (s next : List Bracket) (h : skip p s xs = some next) :
    firstTop p s (xs ++ ys) = (firstTop p next ys).map (offset xs.length)
